/* Premium mining interface: quiet surfaces, strong hierarchy, and motion with restraint. */
:root {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --bg: #090a10;
  --sidebar: #0d0e15;
  --panel: #12131c;
  --panel-raised: #191a25;
  --border: rgba(236, 234, 255, .105);
  --muted: #a4a5b4;
  --text: #f7f6fc;
  --purple: #8c4dff;
  --purple-2: #c3a0ff;
  --green: #48dfae;
  --radius: 20px;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Inter, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
  background: var(--bg);
}

body {
  min-width: 320px;
  color: var(--text);
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 75% 45% at 50% -20%, rgba(113, 62, 203, .18), transparent 70%),
    var(--bg);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

  outline-color: #c6a6ff;
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

  height: 68px;

/* Stable dark contrast, including headings whose color used to rely on browser defaults. */
:root { color-scheme: dark; }

body, #root, .app-shell, .workspace, .page-wrap { color: var(--text); }

.market-item strong, .quest-copy strong, .quest-board-heading h2,
.card-main h3, .explore-copy strong, .section-heading h2 {
  color: var(--text) !important;
